description: This file defines a user interface class 'Ui_Equalizer' for a video equalizer component in a Qt-based application. It sets up various sliders and buttons for adjusting video properties such as brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma, and hue, and includes controls for resetting settings and closing the UI.

classes.name: Ui_Equalizer
classes.description: A class that constructs and configures the UI layout for a video equalizer panel, including sliders for various video adjustments and control buttons.

methods.name: setupUi(self, Equalizer)
methods.description: Initializes the UI components, sets properties such as object names, sizes, layout structure, and connects UI elements to slots.

methods.name: retranslateUi(self, Equalizer)
methods.description: Sets the display text for UI components, supporting translation for internationalization.
